name: Divider
description: A thin horizontal rule between two sections, at content width. Space above and below, line thickness and colour are token-backed settings.
when_to_use: Separate two sections that share a background and would otherwise run into each other. Not for decoration inside a section; most sections already carry their own rules (Stats, FAQ, Features).
capabilities: one rule at content width (container max), no content
spacing: small (12 px) / default (24 px) / large (48 px) above and below

variants.description: A rule at content width. The only variant upstream (pos268).

breakpoints.mobile: Same rule; the side padding follows the section padding of the tier.
breakpoints.desktop: 1 px rule in {color.neutral.border}, {space.24} above and below, container width.

ai.prompt_summary: Divider: a horizontal rule between sections. Settings: variant (contained), spacing (small|default|large), thickness ('1'|'2'|'4' px), color (border|strong|primary|secondary). No text.
ai.content_guidelines: Use sparingly: only where two sections on the same background need a visible break.

field_hints.spacing: Space above and below the line.
field_hints.color: border is the quiet default; primary for a brand accent.
